ownershipAndCache.fact: Every load creates a new BoardModelRealityScene with new root and PerspectiveCamera plus per-scene contact/baseline dictionaries. It calls scene.load, which awaits Entity(contentsOf:sameURL). No app cache returns an existing Entity/scene to two hosts.

Single-instance board uses its newly loaded hierarchy directly. Recursive clone is only for reusable media.instances inside that scene. Do not describe independent Train/Workout loads as cloning one shared app source entity; they invoke separate Entity(contentsOf:) loads. RealityKit may internally share mesh/shader resources, but that is not shared mutable entity ownership demonstrated here.

The so-called source cache stores in-flight tasks/waiters keyed board/presentation/modelSHA and removes loadingentry on completion. LoadedSource holds only resourceLease (URL/ODR lease), no Entity or MeshResource. Store maps board/presentation to assetURL/descriptorURL/resource metadata. Concurrent waiters can share that lease wrapper; each loader still allocates its own scene/entities. Serial model-load gate limits concurrent loads.

Wood/plastic/granite finish values are static immutable material templates. Each model receives its own ModelComponent material array; baselineMaterials is keyed to that scene entity. Highlight constructs a local PhysicallyBasedMaterial value (woodCustomMaterial baseline falls back to new neutral PBR), sets tint/roughness, assigns array on selected entity. No app code mutates a shared material singleton or mesh to highlight. Framework backing resource identity/behavior cannot be established from these Swift value assignments alone.

Each Surface retains its scene in State, resets result toloading onDisappear, and taskcancels by SwiftUI lifetime. Scene retains URL/ODRlease until deinit. Reset is not proof immediate host/entity deallocation: RealityView/framework/task/debugrecorder references may outlive SwiftUI branch. Actual attach/deactivate/remove/deinit census is required; a retained object alone is not an active renderer.
